notes: RapidPro / TextIt REST API v2, authored from the vendor's own source because no machine spec exists: nyaruka/rapidpro temba/api/v2/urls.py is the route inventory (30 resources), the view docstrings are exactly what the /api/v2/<resource> docs pages render, and the read/write serializers give fields, enums and nullability. coverage:full now means the whole v2 API (49 operations: every GET list, POST create/update-by-lookup, DELETE, and the bulk *_actions endpoints), including the deprecated channel_events, definitions and org alias (marked deprecated) and the unpublicized articles/boundaries endpoints. This replaces the earlier scoping to the four resources the adaptor's named functions call (contacts, flow_starts, broadcasts, flows): AGENTS.md requires the whole vendor API, and the rest is reachable from a workflow over HTTP with the same host and token. The original 8 operationIds and their schemas are unchanged apart from additive fields (Contact.ref/notes/blocked/stopped, Broadcast.progress/id, Flow type 'background' and run counts waiting/failed) taken from the serializers. Still best-effort: response shapes come from serializer code and docstring examples, not observed traffic; ticket_actions follows the serializer's action names (add_note, change_topic) where the docstring still says 'note'. Ids are plain strings (no uuid format): openfn-mocker uses readable ids and the docs never state a wire format. BroadcastWrite text/attachments accept a plain string/array as well as a language dict (fields.py TranslatedTextField).
